MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The heat shrink tubing felt useful alongside my electrical terminal assortment because it would help insulate and protect wiring connections.",
    "The Gorilla tread tape felt plausible for a small traction repair because I have bought Gorilla tape before, although traction tape serves a different purpose."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Wire-rope crimps resemble electrical connectors, but they serve a different job; I have no wire-rope project that would make them useful now.",
    "Hose clamps do not mean I need a pressure gauge with this particular range and fitting, and nothing in my purchases establishes a need for grinding discs or a fishing magnet.",
    "The strap, recycling bin and zipper bags could be handy, but general usefulness is not enough for me to choose them without a specific securing or storage need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repair-supply purchases seem to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop equipment, even when it requires a separate project or tool.",
    "Shared words such as wire, clamp and tape seem to count too much when the items perform different tasks."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "A clear connection to supplies I already own matters: protecting electrical terminals is a more convincing next step than starting an unrelated wire-rope project.",
    "The exact purpose and specifications matter to me. Between the two traction tapes, I would choose the wider Gorilla option, but my past duct-tape purchases alone do not establish a traction problem.",
    "My purchases are spread across years, so an older purchase offers a possible connection rather than proof that the same project is still active."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my practical repair interests, but often assumed a specific project from a loose resemblance between supplies."
}
